#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <limits>
#include <cctype>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    if (!(cin >> n)) return 0;
    cin.ignore(numeric_limits<streamsize>::max(), '\n');

    string sLine, beautyLine;
    getline(cin, sLine);
    getline(cin, beautyLine);

    auto trim = [](const string& str) -> string {
        size_t start = 0, end = str.size();
        while (start < end && (unsigned char)str[start] <= ' ') start++;
        while (end > start && (unsigned char)str[end - 1] <= ' ') end--;
        return str.substr(start, end - start);
    };

    string s = trim(sLine);
    string beautyTrim = trim(beautyLine);

    vector<string> tokens;
    string cur;
    for (char c : beautyTrim) {
        if (c == ' ' || c == '\t' || c == '\n' || c == '\x0B' || c == '\f' || c == '\r') {
            tokens.push_back(cur);
            cur.clear();
        } else {
            cur += c;
        }
    }
    tokens.push_back(cur);
    while (!tokens.empty() && tokens.back().empty()) {
        tokens.pop_back();
    }

    vector<int> beauty;
    for (const string& tok : tokens) {
        beauty.push_back(stoi(tok));
    }

    int ans = 0;
    for (int v : beauty) ans += v;

    int m = 0, x = 0, t = 0;
    int count[26] = {0};

    for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
        if (s[i] == s[n - i - 1]) {
            t++;
            count[(int)(s[i] - 'a')]++;
            ans -= min(beauty[i], beauty[n - i - 1]);
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
        if (m < count[i]) {
            m = count[i];
            x = i;
        }
    }

    if (2 * m <= t) {
        cout << ans << endl;
        return 0;
    }

    vector<int> list;
    for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
        int a = s[i] - 'a';
        int b = s[n - i - 1] - 'a';
        if (a != x && b != x && s[i] != s[n - i - 1]) {
            list.push_back(min(beauty[i], beauty[n - i - 1]));
        }
    }
    sort(list.begin(), list.end());

    for (int i = 0; i < 2 * m - t; i++) {
        ans -= list[i];
    }
    cout << ans;

    return 0;
}
